title: Best Video Marketing Experts (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a video marketing expert: YouTube strategy, video ads and distribution, what to include, price factors and red flags.
intro: Video marketing plans which videos to make, where to publish them and how to turn viewers into customers. It covers YouTube channels, short-form video, video ads and videos on your website. It goes wrong when videos are made with no plan for distribution, when success is measured only by views, or when services sell fake views and subscribers. This guide helps you hire for real results.

faq.q: Is video marketing the same as video production?
faq.a: No. Production makes the videos. Marketing decides what to make, for whom, where to publish and how to measure results. Some experts do both.

faq.q: Should I focus on YouTube or short-form video?
faq.a: It depends on your audience and goals. YouTube suits searchable, longer content; short-form suits reach and discovery. Many businesses use both, with different content for each.

faq.q: Can I buy views or subscribers?
faq.a: Fake views and subscribers break platform rules and can harm your channel. Real growth comes from useful content, good titles and thumbnails, and ads that reach real viewers.
It depends on your goal: watch time and subscribers for a channel, clicks and sales for ads, leads for business videos. Views alone rarely tell the full story.

faq.q: Will the expert manage my channel?
faq.a: Some offer channel management, including uploads, titles, descriptions and thumbnails. Keep ownership of the channel and give team access.
